title: Submit a complete enterprise lead request
description: A visitor can fill the contact form, pass Turnstile, and receive the Request Received confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact form section
Fill in the full name field with a valid full name
Fill in the corporate email field with a valid corporate email
Fill in the company name field with a valid company name
Complete Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA
Click the request strategic review button
Verify a Request Received confirmation is visible
Verify the submitted request is acknowledged as sent

title: Complete the diagnostic and view the result
description: A visitor can finish the three-step Growth Friction Index diagnostic and see the resulting EBITDA Yield and severity score.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a measurement input option
Select a visibility input option
Select a velocity input option
Verify the EBITDA Yield result is displayed
Verify the severity score is displayed

title: Reset the diagnostic with Recalculate
description: A visitor can complete the diagnostic and use Recalculate to return to the initial state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a measurement input option
Select a visibility input option
Select a velocity input option
Click Recalculate
Verify the initial diagnostic state is displayed
Verify the result section is no longer displayed

title: Prevent contact submission without Turnstile
description: A visitor who completes the lead form but does not complete Turnstile does not see a successful submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact form section
Fill in the full name field with a valid full name
Fill in the corporate email field with a valid corporate email
Fill in the company name field with a valid company name
Click the request strategic review button
Verify a Turnstile validation error is visible
Verify the success confirmation is not visible

title: Share diagnostic results on WhatsApp
description: A visitor can finish the diagnostic and start sharing the generated results through WhatsApp.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a measurement input option
Select a visibility input option
Select a velocity input option
Click Discuss on WhatsApp
Verify the WhatsApp sharing flow opens
Verify the diagnostic results are included in the share content

title: Open the contact form from the primary CTA
description: A visitor can use the primary call to action to jump to the enterprise lead form.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the primary CTA button
Verify the contact form section is displayed
Verify the lead capture form is visible

title: Open the mobile navigation drawer
description: A mobile visitor can open the hamburger menu and see the navigation drawer.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Resize the browser to a mobile viewport
Click the hamburger menu button
Verify the mobile navigation drawer is displayed
Verify the navigation options are visible

title: Show validation for missing contact details
description: A visitor who submits the lead form without required details sees inline validation instead of a successful request.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact form section
Click the request strategic review button
Verify validation errors are visible for the required fields
Verify the success confirmation is not visible

title: Show validation for an invalid corporate email
description: A visitor entering an invalid corporate email sees validation and does not receive a successful request state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact form section
Fill in the full name field with a valid full name
Fill in the corporate email field with an invalid email format
Fill in the company name field with a valid company name
Click the request strategic review button
Verify a corporate email validation error is visible
Verify the success confirmation is not visible

title: Navigate between sections from the sticky header
description: A visitor can use header navigation links to move to a page section and then reach the contact form.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a navigation link to a landing page section
Verify the corresponding section is displayed
Click the primary CTA button
Verify the contact form section is displayed

title: Use the logo to return to the top of the page
description: A visitor can use the sticky header logo to quickly scroll back to the top of the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact form section
Click the logo in the sticky header
Verify the top of the landing page is displayed
Verify the hero section is visible

title: Verify mobile viewport horizontal scrolling
description: Ensure that on a 375px viewport, there is zero horizontal scroll and all elements fit within 100vw.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Resize the browser to 375px viewport width
Verify there is no horizontal scrollbar (document width equals window width)

title: Verify Low Power Mode CSS animation text visibility
description: Emulate prefers-reduced-motion to simulate Low Power Mode, and verify that the .animate-fade-in-up Hero text has opacity: 1 and is fully visible.

steps.description: Navigate to / with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce enabled
Verify the Hero text is fully visible immediately on page load

title: Verify ARIA landmarks are present
description: Verify that the semantic HTML5 roles for banner, main, and contentinfo exist.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify exactly one element has role='banner'
Verify exactly one element has role='main'
Verify exactly one element has role='contentinfo'
